escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still with real depth of field, the instant the reinforcements arrive inside a vast dark hangar at night, the native layout of a vertical feed ad). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the UPPER 40% of the frame is the deep, evenly dark, navy-black matte ceiling of the hangar with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no trails, no glow, no bokeh, no lamps and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives between 42% and 80% of the frame height. The LOWEST 20% of the frame is the near-black matte rubber top of a launch console right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, with no light and no reflection reaching it. THE MOMENT: Nexa stands slightly RIGHT of center, framed from the waist up, the top of her head at about 46% of the frame height, the console cutting her at the waist so the white plates of her suit end above it; her LEFT arm is raised, fully visible from shoulder to open hand at chest height, welcoming the arrivals. She looks straight into the lens through her clear glasses with a knowing, playful half-smile, head almost frontal, razor-thin focus on her eyes. THE SPARKS, copied EXACTLY from their two references, each smaller than her head, all above her waist: the Content Spark is just arriving next to her raised hand, sharp, still dragging the end of its warm orange (#FF6500) light trail; the Research Spark has just LANDED ON HER RIGHT SHOULDER, one small hand on her shoulder plate, sharp. FAR AWAY in the depth of the hangar, four to twelve meters behind her, EXACTLY FOUR more Sparks (SIX in total, never more), the same figures as the two Spark references, small, clearly OUT OF FOCUS, flying toward her in a loose formation at unequal heights, each drawing a long warm orange light trail behind it, all trails between 44% and 74% of the frame height. LIGHT: the arriving Spark's trail is the only key light on her: hard, warm orange, from the front left and slightly below; NO fill light, the far side of her face in deep shadow with the nose shadow legible. A low cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines her hair and shoulders. She wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering), the bionic glasses exactly as in their reference, small silver earrings, NO watch, NO bracelet, NO ring. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/1.8, nothing foreshortened. Thin haze catches the trails, only below 42%. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, awe-inspiring. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any other brand.
